method: Retained native paths with outer/top/right clips and actual full-page painted backgrounds expanded, all transforms and header-bottom/left limits preserved. Poppler600dpi honours source ICCs into explicit sRGB, followed by original FOGRA39 relative1/noBPC. Only narrow opaque CMYK top/right raster strips are supplied, clipped to3mm bleed plus the previously synthesised0.2mm top/right edge-repair band. All underlying production streams stay byte-identical; no approved artwork is moved or rescaled, and allcontent farther inside the protectedtrim region is untouched.
reconstructibleInputs: Full600dpi RGB rasters and expanded native derivation pages removed after strip extraction for overlay-only runs; hashes retained. Two selected samples remain separately.
